none: PAS WILT-DA5A7A: Roman strap end nail cleaner
contea di ritrovamento: Wiltshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

An incomplete late Roman (AD 300-410) copper alloy strap end nail cleaner. It has been broken at both ends at an early date but tapers at one end to what was almost certainly the bifuricated terminal.
